payQuestions: Clear what, where and how within five seconds?

Worth monthly payment versus a free builder?

gateRules.G0: schema, contract coverage, bound figures/no digits in prose, distinctness, tier limits
gateRules.G1: no overflow/overlap/clipping; gaps >=8px; phone targets >=44px; clean console
gateRules.G2: WCAG AA axe serious/critical zero; keyboard/focus/skip/landmarks/one h1
gateRules.G3: Book above phone fold; step one <=2 taps; tel/sms/prices; metadata/canonical/OG/LocalBusiness areaServed; image alt/dimensions
gateRules.G4: three sequential local mobile Lighthouse runs; median floors and all asset ceilings
gateRules.G5: reduced-motion visibility; transform/opacity/clip-path only; no transition-all/scroll hijacking
